title: Rehabilitation, Patient Education & Health Promotion Quiz

questions.text: What is the overall goal of rehabilitation in this lesson?

answers.text: Maximize functional ability and minimize the impact of disability
Limit care to classroom education only

questions.text: Poor conditioning of muscles leads to inefficient oxygen use and:
Why is psychosocial support included in pulmonary rehabilitation?

answers.text: COPD can reduce motivation and is often associated with anxiety and stress
It replaces the need for exercise testing
It is used only to assign oxygen cylinder size
It eliminates the need for patient education

questions.text: Additional pulmonary rehab tests may include PFTs and exercise tests to establish:

answers.text: A baseline and degree of hypoxia or desaturation

questions.text: Which condition is listed as a contraindication to exercise testing?
In an open-ended pulmonary rehabilitation program design, patients progress until:
For most pulmonary rehab patients, the initial target heart rate is:

answers.text: 20 beats per minute above resting rate
The same as the oxygen flow rate

questions.text: Which item belongs in the pulmonary rehab exercise prescription?

answers.text: Timed walking such as a 6- or 12-minute walk

questions.text: What should be available in the room for pulmonary rehabilitation physical reconditioning?

answers.text: A polysomnogram report for every class

questions.text: Cardiac rehabilitation is designed for patients with:
Which goal is listed for cardiac rehabilitation programs?

answers.text: Improve heart health and work capacity

questions.text: Exercise regimens in cardiac rehabilitation should be customized to the patient's condition, fitness ability, and:
Cardiac rehab education includes disease management topics such as symptoms, risk factors, and:
Monitoring and support systems may use wearable devices and mobile apps to monitor:
Which professional is listed as part of the cardiac rehabilitation multidisciplinary team?
Which statement correctly compares pulmonary and cardiac rehabilitation from the lessons?

answers.text: Both use a multidisciplinary approach with exercise, education, and support
Only cardiac rehabilitation includes any patient education
Only pulmonary rehabilitation uses any program goals

questions.text: Why is patient education important in respiratory care?

answers.text: It is an essential component of patient care
It is used only for classroom staff
It removes the need to verify understanding

questions.text: Which cause is listed as one of the four central preventable causes of major diseases?
In the lesson, culture is defined as:

answers.text: The way patients view health and the need for care interventions
The patient's exercise target heart rate
The accreditation status of a facility

questions.text: Health literacy supports the ability to obtain, process, and understand health information in order to:
Which learning domain focuses on physical skill needed to perform specific treatments?
Which teaching tip is included in the lesson?

answers.text: Address the patient's immediate concerns first

questions.text: Adult learners are described as:

answers.text: Externally motivated and directed by others

questions.text: What is the goal of health education?
Which example belongs under early detection?
Which setting and example are correctly matched for respiratory therapist education?

answers.text: Community - smoking cessation programs and Basic Life Support instruction
Home - anti-smoking educational experiences for teenagers only
